children: According to ChainCatcher citing on-chain analyst @ai_9684xtpa, a whale at address 0x048…cd87d added to its BTC long, bringing its holdings to 728.54 BTC. The position is now the eighth-largest BTC holding on Hyperliquid, with an average entry price of $59,872.80 and an unrealized profit of $828,000.

title: Whale Raises Hyperliquid BTC Long to 728.54 BTC, Eighth-Largest Position
